title: 第20章 天纵奇才第21章 我要你成为一流
content_zh:
“月儿，古武一途是我家世代的传承，因古武能力早已超出了普通人的范畴，我们墨氏家族早已隐世多年，除非出现动乱社会的巨大危机，否则是不会轻易出手的。”
云风看着白月求知的眼神，拂了拂她被晚风吹乱的发丝，眼眸中尽带温柔。
“所以你从小就一直活在深山老林里？”
听到隐世这种词，白月第一个想到的便是云风穿着粗布麻衣，拿着锄头挥舞着种地的场景。
想到这里，不由得“噗嗤”笑出来。
云风看着这妮子捂嘴坏笑的模样，就知道她定是在想些不正经的东西。
“怎么可能是深山老林呢，都7991年了，很快就进入21世纪了。我们家族隐世并不是与世隔绝，只是不轻易让然知道我们会古武罢了，平常还是跟平常人一样正常生活。”
“原来如此，所以你现在是要手把手教我吗？”
白月看着云风，一脸坏笑道。
“咳咳...”
云风没想到突然被白月反将一军，脸立马红到耳根子去，他这是被调戏了？
“怎么说，古武境界的划分分为天、地、玄、黄四个等级。”
云风只好转移话题的道。
“黄级练气吐纳，开通灵窍；玄级力大无穷，开碑裂石；地级身轻如燕，飞檐走壁；因为现世灵气的缺乏，天级在现世几乎已经不存在了，不过若达到天级则可以外放真气护体，刀枪不入。”
“现在我还是先教你吐纳的法门吧。”
说着云风便开始盘坐调息，让真气在经脉不断流转，最终汇入丹田之内。
白月看着也有样学样，盘坐在露台的地上，学着云风调息的动作，开始缓缓的吐纳。
“静心，凝神，慢慢的感受天地间那一缕缕捉摸不透的灵气，感受灵气需要一个过程，我当初在家族的聚灵阵内也还需要约莫一周的功夫才能感应到灵气，所以你不必着急，你以后每晚就这样边吐纳边感受灵气的存在...”
云风收起架势，看着白月缓缓道。
“咦？”

白月突然疑惑的叫了一声。
“有什么问题？”
云风紧张的凑上前去，生怕白月练功一个不小心会误伤自己。
“我好像...感受到了空气中有一丝丝白色的雾状气体，一直源源不断的往我丹田里飘去，这些就是灵气吗？”
白月闭着眼睛感应着，欣喜的抓着云风问道。
！！！
怎么肥四？
“月儿，你...你真看到有一丝丝的白色雾气飘进你丹田了？”
云风一副见鬼了的表情。
“是啊，而且这些雾气飘到体内凉凉的，可舒服了呢。”
白月像是发现了新世界的大门，不断的观察着这些灵气的走向，玩得不亦乐乎。
“还舒服？！入门新手刚感应到灵气不是应该感觉到寒凉彻骨，丹田内涌进了灵气不应该还有些胀痛不适的吗？！”
云风觉得自己这下真的见鬼了，他从小修炼，包括他家族的人在内，就没见过谁说修炼是舒服的！
谁不是在一次次真气虚脱枯竭下才渐渐成长起来，若是修炼舒服那高手还不得遍地走。
骨骼惊奇，天纵奇才！
云风内心除了感叹也就只剩下感叹了，没办法，人家修炼瞬间感应灵气，还能内视丹田感到舒服，他们这些苦逼埋头苦憋一周半月，甚至有些人一辈子都感应不到灵气的，还能说什么呢？
只能说同人不同命，得认啊。
content_en:
"Yue'er, ancient martial arts has been passed down from generation to generation in my family. Because the ability of ancient martial arts has long been beyond the scope of ordinary people, our Mo family has been hidden from the world for many years. Unless there is a huge crisis that destabilizes society, we will not take action easily."
Yunfeng looked at Bai Yue's eyes that were seeking knowledge, and brushed her hair that was messed up by the evening breeze, with gentleness in her eyes.
"So you have been living in the mountains and forests since you were a child?"
When Bai Yue heard the word "seclusion", the first thing that came to mind was the scene of Yunfeng wearing coarse linen clothes, holding a hoe and farming.
Thinking of this, I couldn't help but laugh out loud.
Yunfeng looked at the girl covering her mouth and smiling evilly, and knew that she must be thinking about something inappropriate.
"How could it be deep in the mountains and old forests? It's already 7991 years ago, and we will soon enter the 21st century. Our family's seclusion does not mean that we are isolated from the world, it's just that we don't easily know that we know ancient martial arts, and we still live a normal life like ordinary people."
"I see, so you want to teach me step by step now?"
Bai Yue looked at Yunfeng and said with a wicked smile.
"Ahem..."
Yunfeng didn't expect that Bai Yue would suddenly turn his army against him, and his face immediately turned red to the roots of his ears. Was he being teased?
"How should I put it? The realm of ancient martial arts is divided into four levels: heaven, earth, Xuan, and Huang."
Yunfeng had no choice but to change the subject.
"The Huang level practices breathing and breathing, opening spiritual orifices; the Xuan level has infinite power, opening monuments and cracking rocks; the Earth level is as light as a swallow, flying over eaves and walking on walls; due to the lack of spiritual energy in the world, the Heaven level almost no longer exists in this world, but if you reach the Heaven level, you can release your true energy to protect your body, making you invulnerable."
"Now I'd better teach you the method of vomiting."
As he spoke, Yunfeng began to sit cross-legged and regulate his breathing, allowing the true energy to continuously flow through his meridians and eventually flow into his Dantian.
Bai Yue followed suit, sitting cross-legged on the terrace, imitating Yunfeng's breathing movements, and began to breathe slowly.
"Be still, concentrate, and slowly feel the elusive spiritual energy between heaven and earth. Feeling the spiritual energy requires a process. It still took me about a week to feel the spiritual energy in the family's spirit gathering array, so you don't have to worry. From now on, you can feel the existence of the spiritual energy while breathing in and out every night..."
Yunfeng put away his stance, looked at Bai Yue and said slowly.
"Huh?"
Bai Yue suddenly called out in confusion.
"What's the problem?"
Yunfeng stepped forward nervously, fearing that Bai Yue might accidentally injure himself while practicing.
"I seem to...feel a trace of white mist-like gas in the air, floating continuously into my Dantian. Is this spiritual energy?"
Bai Yue closed her eyes and felt it, grabbing Yunfeng happily and asked.
! ! !
How come you are so fat?
"Yue'er, you...did you really see a trace of white mist floating into your Dantian?"
Yunfeng looked like he had seen a ghost.
"Yes, and the mist drifts into the body and cools the body, which is very comfortable."
Bai Yue seemed to have discovered the door to a new world, constantly observing the direction of these spiritual energies and having a great time.
"Still comfortable?! Shouldn't a novice who has just sensed the spiritual energy feel a chill to the bone? Shouldn't there be some pain and discomfort as the spiritual energy pours into the Dantian?!"
Yunfeng felt that he had really seen a ghost now. He had been practicing since he was a child, and he had never seen anyone, including members of his family, say that practicing was comfortable!
Who doesn't gradually grow up after repeated exhaustion of true energy? If the cultivation is comfortable, the master will not be able to travel everywhere.
Amazing bones, genius!
Yunfeng could only sigh in his heart. There was nothing he could do about it. People could sense spiritual energy in an instant and feel comfortable by looking into their Dantian through cultivation. But these hard-working people had to work hard for a week and a half, and some of them even couldn't sense spiritual energy in their entire lives. What else could they say?
It can only be said that people with the same fate have different fates, so you have to admit it.
